stages.headline: A circle is the set of points at the same distance from a given point O (the centre); that distance is the radius.
stages.headlineEnglish: A circle is the set of points at the same distance from a given point O (the centre); that distance is the radius.

stages.headline: A segment joining two points of a circle is a chord; a chord through the centre is a diameter, d = 2r.
stages.headlineEnglish: A segment joining two points of a circle is a chord; a chord through the centre is a diameter, d = 2r.

stages.headline: Two points split a circle into two arcs; the part of the plane bounded by a circle is a disc.
